description: Vonit keeps this chat's thread so another agent can continue it. Each hook only leaves a note for the Vonit Connector on this computer and returns at once; it sends nothing itself and never stops Claude Code. Without the Connector, or without chat sync turned on, they do nothing.

hooks.command: vonit-connector thread hook SessionStart --agent claude_code 2>/dev/null || true
vonit-connector thread hook Stop --agent claude_code 2>/dev/null || true
vonit-connector thread hook PreCompact --agent claude_code 2>/dev/null || true
vonit-connector thread hook SessionEnd --agent claude_code 2>/dev/null || true
